verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for an authentication product, but the evidence documents only in-app UI flows: approving sign-ins, scanning QR codes, toggling backup, and exporting passwords. None of it shows a public API that mirrors those actions, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (all 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
